thoughts: The current CTR is significantly below target (7.8% vs 25%) primarily due to a failure in text legibility. The dark blue headline and green subheadline completely disappear into the complex, multi-colored background of the futuristic city and vehicle. The contrast ratio is well below the 4.5:1 standard. Retention is close to target, but the video movement feels a bit static and architectural rather than kinetic. To fix this, we need to switch to high-contrast white typography with a grounding overlay and inject more dynamic camera movement into the video prompt to hook users instantly.
contrast_audit: Fail - The #3B456C headline and #2E7D32 subheadline lack sufficient luminance against the sunset sky and metallic vehicle textures, making the value proposition unreadable at a glance.
